rationale: After 35 minutes in the trade, price has failed to sustain momentum after reaching $101.56 and has broken below the 5-minute 9-EMA ($101.21), currently trading at $101.11. Because a key premise of the entry was holding above this fast moving average during a breakout, the loss of the 9-EMA combined with stalling price action back at entry warrants closing at break-even rather than waiting for the $100.75 invalidation level to be hit.
